what: NDT-UPDATE (2026-10-17): the AdamW update's commit and first pass, bit for bit. The commit's two divisions an element by the bias corrections 1 - beta1^t and 1 - beta2^t, which every element of a call shares, as div_shared: y = RN(1/d) once a call, q0 = x*y, two FMA corrections -- the second Markstein's (Handbook of Floating-Point Arithmetic, 2nd ed., Theorem 4.10: for a faithful q and y within half an ulp of 1/d, r = x - q*d is exact and RN(q + r*y) is RN(x/d)) -- and copysign for a zero's sign, in the AVX-512 commit and a new AVX2+FMA commit (the commit's variant bit 8, set where the fused GEMM's variants carry AVX2, which they do only with FMA); the portable commit, the FMA-less AVX2 commit and the preflight keep the divisions, and each element's own division and root stay. The first pass under the reduce contract on a vector variant two chunks a task (pair_avx512, pair_avx2): both chunks' flag and maxima a vector at a time and each chunk's squares added to its own chain in index order between the loads, so the chains run under the four streams' reads and each under the other's latency; any other chunk takes the per-chunk loop.
